_about: T915 placeholder, filled by a later harvest. Per beach id (the beaches wire id): {sea_temp?: [12 numbers, monthly mean sea surface temperature in C, January first], shade?: true|false (trees or cover within 50 m of the sand), step_free?: true|false, sunbeds?: {eur_day}, lifeguard_season?: [fromMonth, toMonth], waves?: "calm"|"moderate"|"surf", access?: {parking?: {name?, lat, lon, m, fee?, eur_day?}, transit?: [{name, mode, lat, lon, m}]}}. A value here wins over the derived one. sea_temp is derived first from the T641 NASA MUR harvest (cache/sea_temp_beaches.json, pipeline/harvest_sea_temp.py) when that file is on disk. Figueirinha (pt-figueirinha-beach-Q10352598) is the worked example.

pt-figueirinha-beach-Q10352598._note: Sheltered under the Arrabida cliffs. Sunbed price, lifeguard dates and sea temperature not checked yet.
